sloka: एवं स रावणः प्राप्तः कार्तवीर्यात्प्रधर्षणम् ।पुलस्त्यवचनाच्चापि पुनर्मुक्तो महाबलः ।। ७.३३.२१ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ sa rāvaṇaḥ prāptaḥ kārtavīryātpradharṣaṇam ।pulastyavacanāccāpi punarmukto mahābalaḥ ।। 7.33.21 ॥

translations.english: Thus, the mighty Ravana, having experienced humiliation at the hands of Kartavirya, was again released due to the intervention and words of Pulastya.
